csrf-token-form.suggestion: CSRF token found in form. Good practice.

csrf-token-page-level.suggestion: The page exposes a CSRF token in a meta tag. Make sure this form's submission actually sends it (e.g. in an X-CSRF-Token header via JavaScript); a plain HTML form submit will not.

csrf-token-meta.suggestion: CSRF token found in meta tag. Good practice.

csrf-token-cookie.suggestion: Readable CSRF cookie (double-submit pattern). This is expected; make sure the server compares it with a header or form value and that the cookie uses SameSite.

readable-auth-cookie.suggestion: Session and auth tokens should be set with HttpOnly so an XSS bug cannot read them, plus Secure and SameSite.

sensitive-form-no-csrf.suggestion: Include CSRF protection for state-changing requests (a synchronizer token field, or SameSite cookies plus an Origin check).

scanner-error.suggestion: Scanner encountered an error. Check console for details.
